blocked_reason: Experiment D requires chronological out-of-fold base and follow probabilities on development rows. The available train_predictions.parquet files are in-sample model outputs, so training a meta-gate on them would violate the plan and overstate validation performance.
why_not_using_available_train_prediction: train_predictions.parquet is generated from models fit on the same development rows. It is suitable for diagnostics, but not for training the OOF meta-gate requested in the plan.
